svg.text: Spotting sync words: a normalised correlator made of stock blocks

svg.text: ρ = Σ tₖ xₖ / ( ‖t‖ · √( Σ xₖ² − (Σ xₖ)² / 24 ) )
Strength cancels (divided by σ). A tuning offset cancels (every template has as many +3 as −3). Range −1 … +1.
(b) The template FIR: 231 taps, zero except every 10th (BS voice sync)
(c) ρ from the BS template: voice on TS1, control on TS2
